manifest_range_semantics: inclusive uint32 [first,last]; wrap uses separate ranges

receiver_timing.clock: user-space monotonic processing timestamps; not NIC/kernel arrival or cross-host latency

policy.first_request_round: first available poll after ingest discovery, or current poll for silence discovery
policy.no_observations: observed=false and null extrema/quantiles: not measured, never a passing timing observation
policy.duration_resolution: nearest microsecond; nonnegative durations clamp sub-epsilon negative lateness to zero; early counters compare original seconds with scheduler epsilon
policy.quantiles: all observations; fixed 100us bucket upper bounds through 100ms; overflow uses observed maximum
policy.request_budget: generation consumes a request even if local sendto fails; duplicate-nack injection may transmit extra copies
policy.newer_frame_timing: predicate and registration share the ingest processing timestamp, so delay is zero by construction; tail_newer_frame_age measures time since last unique fragment
policy.frame_expiry: earliest still-missing discovery to frame retirement; third_request_to_expiry includes only actually due third-request fragments

denominators.silence_tail_lateness: tail_silence_discoveries (frames with newly discovered tail fragments)
denominators.newer_frame_to_tail_discovery: tail_newer_frame_discoveries (frames with newly discovered tail fragments)
denominators.third_request_to_expiry: third_expiry_fragments; later incomplete fragments cancelled by the same frame expiry excluded

evidence_denominators.early_expiries: expired_frames (retired without any third-request fragment actually due)

events.policy: most recent diagnostic events; one discovery batch/request round per frame, not full per-packet logs

runtime.observation_points: ingest/poll processing timestamps; request generation precedes socket sendto
runtime.poll_cadence: after at most 64 datagrams or a checked 250us batch; select timeout 1ms; OS scheduling can exceed these budgets

request_budget_policy: consumed at generation even if local sendto fails; no local retry
receive_time_source: user-space monotonic processing; not NIC/kernel arrival
checkpoint_policy: optional OSError is counted and skipped until next regular cadence; final report failure remains fatal
nack_budget_policy: consumed at generation; failed sendto consumes request; no unbounded local retries

batch_limits.note: budget checked after each datagram; individual decode/complete may exceed it

timing_note: User-space monotonic processing times, not kernel/NIC arrivals. Python is not hard real-time.

acceptance_table.note: 各行仅覆盖所列测量口径；缺少硬件、物理链路或渲染证据时不宣称完整协议达标。
